run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute sum divided by absolute difference of negative and positive counts in an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using parameterized test cases with arrays and element counts
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which counts negatives and positives then returns sum over their absolute difference
